entry.description: Write characters the encoding cannot represent as `\uXXXX` in `FileAppender`, `RollingFileAppender`, `UdpAppender` and both `SmtpAppender` classes. They used to become `?`, U+FFFD or a look-alike character. On .NET Framework the default encoding is the ANSI code page, so text outside it, such as Cyrillic or Chinese, now shows as escapes unless you set `utf-8` (fixed by @FreeAndNil)
